verified_current_implementation.finding: Optional perceptual loss compares decoded predicted x0 to decoded target latent. It does not compare to the original RGB reference. Open-H3 main objective is warm-start x0 latent MSE.
verified_current_implementation.implication: This objective does not directly penalize the original-RGB reconstruction discrepancy measured by the VAE diagnostic; it is not proof of an irreducible VAE quality bound.

verified_current_implementation.finding: Each training sigma independently mixes draft and Gaussian noise; deployed three-step sampling traverses its previous model states.
verified_current_implementation.implication: Record this as an adaptation approximation. A new full-trajectory objective needs forward/backward and memory acceptance, not an assertion that the old loss equals final deployed RGB training.

verified_current_implementation.finding: Training explicitly carries sigma-scaled random audio. Current inference uses zero audio latent-image plus sampler noise.
verified_current_implementation.implication: Do not infer a mismatch merely from zeros versus randn labels; verify actual model stream tensors at the declared schedule before changing audio.
